channel.title: Femp blog
channel.description: Field notes for Shopify and Amazon brand owners from the team behind Femp.

item.title: Your store makes a story every day. Here's how to post it everywhere.
item.description: Most store owners run their own social and burn out. Turn restocks, reviews and launches into daily stories, size them for every channel, and track which ones sell.

item.title: Your Meta pixel is missing sales. Here's how to tell, and how to fix it.
item.description: When the pixel misses purchases, Meta optimizes on bad data and your ads look worse than they are. How to spot the gap and fix tracking on Shopify.

item.title: 7 out of 10 carts never check out. Here's how to win some back.
item.description: About 70% of online carts are abandoned. Why buyers leave at checkout, the Shopify fixes that work, and a recovery email sequence that doesn't nag.

item.title: 47 ops jobs you can hand to an AI assistant, and the ones you shouldn't
item.description: Most ops work at a DTC brand is watching, reconciling and chasing. 47 jobs an AI operations assistant can take over, and what should stay human.

item.title: Your ads say they're profitable. Your store disagrees.
item.description: Meta and Google both claim the same sale. A simple daily check of ad spend against real Shopify orders that finds the ad sets losing money.

item.title: Most chargebacks are lost to a buried email. Here's how to win them.
item.description: An unanswered chargeback costs the order, the product and a fee. The evidence that wins each dispute type, and how to never miss a deadline.

item.title: Why ChatGPT doesn't recommend your products, and how to fix it
item.description: Shoppers now ask ChatGPT and Google's AI what to buy. What gets a product into those answers, with a checklist for titles, descriptions and data.

item.title: Your best seller is about to sell out. This number warns you first.
item.description: "40 left" means nothing without your sales pace. How to calculate days of cover, set a reorder point, and stop advertising sold-out products.

item.title: You're owed money in your invoices. Here's where it's hiding.
item.description: Payout shortfalls, carrier refunds, 3PL overcharges and invalid retailer deductions quietly take a few percent of revenue. Where to check weekly.

item.title: The DTC compliance calendar: every deadline that can cost you money
item.description: Sales tax nexus, 1099s, state reports, SMS consent, Prop 65 and accessibility: the deadlines a US DTC brand misses until the penalty letter arrives.
